verdict.rationale: Sprinto's quickstart claims continuous monitoring with alerts (sprinto-docs-3, sprinto-docs-25), and it documents Jira and ClickUp integrations. However, the ClickUp setup sits under Change Management as a monitored ticketing system, and the Jira page is only a title, so neither shows control failures being pushed out as tickets. The webhooks are inbound-only, and the status-page email (sprinto-docs-51) covers Sprinto's own incidents, not customer findings. Missing for 10: Slack alerting, documented email alerts on control failures or drift, auto-creation of tickets from failed checks, remediation context in alerts, and independent corroboration.
